	-- Simple UI dragger (PC Only/Any device that has a mouse) --
	
	local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
	local frame = script.Parent
	local dragToggle = nil
	local dragSpeed = 0.25
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	local function updateInput(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()

			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragToggle then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function GetTarget()
	local now=tick()
	if now-tT<TR and tC and tC.Parent then
		local hum=tC.Parent and tC.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");if hum and hum.Health>0 then return tC end
	end
	local mouse=UIS:GetMouseLocation();local best,bd=nil,CFG.FOV
	local function Check(model)
		if model==LP.Character then return end
		local hum=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
		local head=model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not head then return end
		local sp,on=Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position);if not on then return end
		local dist=(Vector2.new(sp.X,sp.Y)-mouse).Magnitude
		if dist<bd then if CFG.WallCheck and not LOS(Cam.CFrame.Position,head.Position) then return end;best=head;bd=dist end
	end
	if CFG.TargetPlayers then for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP and p.Character and not IsTeammate(p) then Check(p.Character) end end end
	if CFG.TargetNPCs then for _,v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("Humanoid") and v.Health>0 and v.Parent and v.Parent~=LP.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v.Parent) then Check(v.Parent) end end end
	tC=best;tT=now;return best
end

local FullbrightEnabled = false
local OriginalBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
local OriginalClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
local OriginalFogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
local OriginalGlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
local OriginalOutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient

local function ToggleFullbright()
    FullbrightEnabled = not FullbrightEnabled
    
    if FullbrightEnabled then
        -- ON: すべてを明るく、影を消す
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14 -- 昼間に固定
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000 -- 霧を消す
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false -- 影を消す
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
        
        MainButton.Text = "暗視\nON"
        MainButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100) -- 緑（ON）
        UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
    else
        -- OFF: 元の設定に戻す
        Lighting.Brightness = OriginalBrightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = OriginalClockTime
        Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalFogEnd
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = OriginalGlobalShadows
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = OriginalOutdoorAmbient
        
        MainButton.Text = "暗視\nOFF"
        MainButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100) -- 赤（OFF）
        UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    end
end

-- イベント接続
MainButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleFullbright)

-- ゲーム側でLighting設定が強制変更された時の対策

        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end
end)
